title: Neon Pulse — Episode 17: Vance's End Game
description: Kael tracks Commander Vance to a subterranean facility and uncovers a massive plot.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: Smoke cleared to reveal the shattered core of the data hub. Vance was already gone, leaving behind only a pulsing secondary beacon.
scenes.visual: Wide low angle shot of a ruined subterranean chamber filled with rising steam and dangling sparking wires, camera tracking forward slowly over scorched metallic debris

scenes.narration: Tracing the beacon's frequency led straight into the abandoned railway tunnels beneath the city. The amber circuitry on my sleeves flared in response to the hidden power surge.
scenes.visual: Medium tracking shot inside a dark damp concrete subway tunnel illuminated only by faint orange light glowing from a man's outstretched arms

scenes.narration: Heavy steel blast doors blocked the path forward, but my engineered resonance tore through the locking mechanism in seconds.
scenes.visual: Close up shot of hands pressed against massive scarred metal doors while bright golden energy arcs crackle across the heavy bolts

scenes.narration: Beyond the doors lay a sprawling subterranean laboratory bathed in cold blue light. Hundreds of containment pods lined the walls, each one humming with trapped energy.
scenes.visual: Over the shoulder view looking into a vast high tech underground chamber filled with glowing vertical glass cylinders stretching into deep shadows

scenes.narration: A familiar voice echoed from the central console. Commander Vance stepped out from the shadows, smiling as if expecting this exact reunion.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of an older military commander standing near glowing computer banks with arms crossed, looking directly forward with a confident expression

scenes.narration: You cannot outrun what you were built to become, Kael. This entire facility was designed to harvest your exact frequency.
scenes.visual: Close up shot of a man staring intensely forward with narrowed eyes while ambient blue monitors cast harsh light across his face

scenes.narration: Floor plates dropped away instantly, plunging the center of the room into a deep chasm of raw, uncontained energy. Vance vanished upward on a security lift.
scenes.visual: High angle shot of concrete flooring collapsing downward into a glowing abyss while a figure lunges backward to grab a crumbling ledge

scenes.narration: Hanging over the abyss, I had to channel every ounce of power just to keep from falling into the core. Vance had won this round, but the war was far from over.
scenes.visual: Low angle dramatic shot of a man straining with one hand gripping a fractured concrete edge while bright amber energy surges up his arms

scenes.narration: Follow along for more chapters of the Neon Pulse saga as the battle for the truth continues.
scenes.visual: Medium portrait shot of a man standing resolute in a dark industrial corridor with glowing amber patterns fading softly on his jacket
